commitResults.messageTitle: Update the initial code to simply greet the user and exit.
Handled errors, refactored code and added delete feature
Add task loading with structured file persistence
Handle corrupted task data and storage error
Extract task list management into TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Encapsulate task collection operations behind a dedicated TaskList class while preserving Friday's command flow, storage behavior, and console output. Keep Friday responsible for orchestration and expose only a read-only view for persistence and display.

Move task-file path management, loading, saving, record parsing, date reconstruction, escaping, and corruption warnings out of Friday. Keep Friday responsible for coordinating the session and presenting storage warnings while preserving existing behavior.

Move command classification, task creation, date parsing, validation, and task-number parsing out of Friday. Keep Friday focused on executing typed commands and preserving the existing console behavior.

Move command input and all user-facing output from Friday into Ui, leaving Friday responsible for coordinating parsing, task updates, storage, and error flow while preserving existing console transcripts.

Replace Parser's tagged command record with an abstract Command hierarchy for add, delete, exit, list, mark, and unmark operations. Each command owns its task mutation and UI response, while Friday coordinates parsing, guarded persistence, and loop termination.
Merge the Ui extraction and executable command hierarchy into master, preserving the refactored application coordination structure.

Move the application, command, model, parser, storage, UI, and exception classes beneath the friday package hierarchy while keeping src/main/java as the source root. Update the UI test runner for recursive compilation and the packaged entry point, and refresh the README path.
Merge the package hierarchy, packaged application entry point, and recursive UI test support into master.
Point the Gradle application plugin at friday.Friday, the packaged chatbot entry point, so Gradle run tasks launch the current application.
Merge Gradle build support and the corrected packaged application entry point into master.
Cover successful task removal, order preservation, returned values, and invalid-index behavior for empty and non-empty lists.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand JUnit coverage for core logic
commitResults.messageBody: Cover all public TaskList operations and boundary behavior, command parsing and validation, and storage round trips, missing files, and corrupted records. These tests target the highest-value business logic and raise automated coverage across the core classes.
Set the approximate 50 percent high-value method coverage target and require updating or adding JUnit tests after each code change, followed by running the Gradle test suite.
Merge the high-value JUnit coverage and documented 50 percent testing target into master.
Configure the Shadow plugin to produce friday-all.jar with friday.Friday as its manifest entry point, include the artifact in the build lifecycle, and document how to create and run it.
Merge executable Shadow JAR configuration and usage documentation into master.
